column3: Text-like attachments are inlined up to 64 KiB per turn; images stay at 1 MiB; SVG counts as text
column4: The spec said a text file is never inlined, so every brief cost the model a tool call; 64 KiB is about 16k tokens at worst, far below any window and the DO row. Providers accept only raster image parts, so SVG goes as text
column5: plugins/intake/attachments.test.ts 'inlines text files up to the text budget' and 'treats an SVG as text'
